questions.text: State Newton's first law of motion.
answer: An object stays at rest or keeps moving
with constant velocity in a straight line
unless an external force acts on it.

questions.text: Explain why ionic compounds conduct electricity in the molten state but not in the solid state.
answer: In the solid state the ions are held in a fixed
lattice and cannot move. When molten, the ions
become free to move and carry current.

questions.text: Name the organelle in which photosynthesis occurs and the pigment that traps sunlight.

answer: (in the presence of sunlight and chlorophyll)

questions.text: Describe how oxygen is transported around the human body.
answer: Oxygen is carried by white blood cells.
It travels through the veins to the body cells
where it is used for respiration.

Write a short paragraph (about 40 words) on why reading is important.
answer: Reading is important because it improves our
vocabulary and imagination. Books teach us new
things and help us understand other people.
It also makes us better writers.

questions.text: Rewrite in the passive voice: "The chef cooked a delicious meal."
answer: A delicious meal is cooked by the chef.

questions.text: Explain the meaning of the idiom "break the ice".
answer: It means to start a conversation in a
social situation so that people feel relaxed.
